_provenance.statement: Every file here was written by PrusaSlicer 2.9.6 itself. A candidate model config was placed in a genuine PrusaSlicer project and handed back with --export-3mf; what the slicer wrote is what is stored. One variable per file. Nothing was hand-edited afterwards.
_provenance.geometry: a 12-facet cube — synthetic, no private model

A_no_assignment_out.3mf.note: no extruder metadata at all — PrusaSlicer wrote none back

B_object_slot1_out.3mf.note: explicit extruder=1 — PrusaSlicer kept it explicit rather than dropping it

M_object_slot6_out.3mf.note: extruder=6 on a four-filament machine — not clamped

inst3_out.3mf.note: three build items — instances_count came back as 3

H_two_volumes_different_slots_out.3mf.note: one object, two volumes on filaments 2 and 5

vt_ParameterModifier_out.3mf.note: a ModelPart and a ParameterModifier in one object

vt_ModifierMesh_out.3mf.note: the old Slic3r role word — PrusaSlicer rewrote it to ModelPart

N_object_and_volume_disagree_out.3mf.note: object extruder=2 with a volume saying 4 — both kept

J_per_object_override_out.3mf.note: layer_height, fill_density and support_material set on the object
